figcaption.caption: Welcome to our newest team members joining this quarter

textItems.title: Expanding Our Capabilities
textItems.paragraph: We're excited to announce that we're growing our team with 15 new positions across engineering, design, and customer success. This expansion will help us better serve our customers and accelerate product development.

textItems.title: Open Positions
textItems.paragraph: We're currently hiring for senior engineers, UX designers, and customer success managers. If you're passionate about building great products and helping customers succeed, we'd love to hear from you.
